methods.source_location: Paragraphs 4, 7, and 15; Supporting Information Table S1 and readme
methods.scope: all 25 Supporting Information Table S1 pressures

recalculation.notes: Every row reports Pt 111 d-spacing. For fcc Pt, a=sqrt(3)*d111 and V=a^3; evaluation with the bundled Holmes record reproduces the rounded source pressures with 0.269 GPa RMSE and 0.462 GPa maximum difference using the exact Equation (11) coefficients. Pt 200 is retained but the authors explicitly used only Pt 111 to reduce nonhydrostatic bias.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

primary_source_check.source_version: author-hosted copy of the final published GRL article plus publisher Supporting Information
locations: Supporting Information Table S1 and readme
primary_source_check.finding: The source selects a constrained room-temperature BM3 fit for CaIrO3-type Cmcm MgGeO3 post-perovskite, fixes K0'=4.4, and excludes only its three rows below 47 GPa.

primary_data_check.finding: All 25 source rows are bundled with lattice-parameter 1-sigma errors, Pt 111 and 200 spacings, Holmes-scale pressure, deviatoric stress, and exposure timing. Exactly 22 rows are marked fit-included.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Abstract; Experimental method, paragraphs 4-9; Results and discussion, paragraphs 10-19; Tables 1-2; Figure 3; Supporting Information Table S1 and readme.
parameter_provenance.equation: Paragraph 7 identifies a third-order Birch-Murnaghan P-V fit; paragraph 17 and Table 2 give the selected result.
parameter_provenance.V0: Abstract, paragraph 17, and Table 2: 179.2(7) A^3 for the conventional Cmcm cell; fitted/extrapolated.
parameter_provenance.K0: Abstract, paragraph 17, and Table 2: 207(5) GPa; fitted under the source's K*V elasticity-systematics constraint.
parameter_provenance.reference_pressure: The Birch-Murnaghan coefficients are zero-pressure values.
parameter_provenance.reference_temperature: Abstract and Figure 3: experimental fit at room temperature/300 K.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Paragraph 16 excludes data below 47 GPa; 22 of the 25 Supporting Information Table S1 rows from 47.3 to 196.3 GPa remain.
parameter_provenance.fit_constraint: Paragraph 17 adds K*V=constant elasticity systematics for a given crystal structure using MgSiO3 post-perovskite reference values because low-pressure data were unavailable.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: The source reports parenthetical/plus-minus uncertainties for V0 and K0 but gives no confidence convention, covariance matrix, or uncertainty for the fixed K0_prime.

source_lineage.role: published EOS equation, selected coefficients, uncertainty, fit selection, structure, and pressure calibration
